# Tampa Kids Dentistry

> > A specialized pediatric dental practice in Tampa, Florida led by Dr. Catalina Botero and team, providing comprehensive children's dental care with a focus on cavity prevention and patient comfort.

Tampa Kids Dentistry (also known as Li'l Sunshine Smiles) is a dedicated pediatric dental practice serving the Tampa, Florida area. The practice is staffed by experienced pediatric dentists including Dr. Catalina Botero, Dr. Marcio Ortegosa, and Dr. Mana Watanabe, all trained in specialized children's dental care and affiliated with professional organizations like the American Association of Pediatric Dentists.
